notes: Relation insert; the inverse and the asymmetry the prompts state are already RELATIONS.md tags (also given). q0 needs Richard II's reign years (fol, temporal).

fol.notes: Years are Int. The edit's relation is dated, so flint_pledged_to(k, y) is the kingdom k was flint-pledged to in year y (an enumeration with other_kingdom). Richard II's reign years are stored (in_office_from, in_office_until); the firm rule reads the ruler of England in a year off the reign that contains it (ruled_by, record-local). Kings are an enumeration with other_king, so the reign rule, not a closed list, picks Richard II.

local.ruled_by: ruled_by(k, y): the monarch who ruled kingdom k in year y.

richard_reign.says: Richard II was King of England from 1377 to 1399. (stored)

reign_rule.says: A king of England rules England in every year of his reign.
reign_rule.z3: ForAll(y, Implies(And(in_office_from(richard_ii, king_of_england) <= y, y <= in_office_until(richard_ii, king_of_england)), ruled_by(england, y) == richard_ii))
